scope_note: Named, cross-agency or cross-sector federal science and technology missions, initiatives, and national efforts relevant to quantum technology, AI, cybersecurity, energy, discovery science, and national security. upcoming_milestones.summary: The January 9 strategy directed initial demonstrations within six months and monthly senior-leader progress reviews.
upcoming_milestones.title: Conduct initial Pace-Setting Project demonstrations with transition-partner users

upcoming_milestones.summary: Executive Order 14412 gives each agency 30 days to identify a lead reporting to its chief information officer.
upcoming_milestones.title: Agencies identify and report their PQC migration leads

upcoming_milestones.summary: Executive Order 14363 set a 240-day review of robotic laboratories, production facilities, and enabling standards.
upcoming_milestones.title: Review federal robotic and AI-directed laboratory capabilities

upcoming_milestones.summary: DARPA invited additional distinct technical approaches not yet evaluated under QBI.
upcoming_milestones.title: Receive abstracts for the expanded QBIT Stage A solicitation

upcoming_milestones.summary: Executive Order 14363 set a 270-day objective, subject to law and available appropriations.
upcoming_milestones.title: Seek initial platform operating capability for at least one national challenge

upcoming_milestones.summary: The order gives OMB 90 days to issue guidance in consultation with CISA and the National Cyber Director.
upcoming_milestones.title: OMB issues agency guidance for inventories, migration plans, and high-impact systems

upcoming_milestones.summary: DOE must identify specifications for transformative applications beyond current classical capabilities.
upcoming_milestones.title: Publish a summary of QC-ADDS technical specifications

upcoming_milestones.summary: DARPA states that the nonprofit-administered forum will launch in summer 2026; no exact date is published.
upcoming_milestones.title: Launch the AI Forge university-industry-government forum

upcoming_milestones.summary: Selected entrants will describe a full utility-scale system concept and evidence supporting its feasibility.
upcoming_milestones.title: Close the QBIT Stage A full-proposal window

upcoming_milestones.summary: The topic supports independent technical verification and validation of participating approaches.
upcoming_milestones.title: Close the QBI independent verification and validation topic

upcoming_milestones.summary: DARPA lists this as the deadline for the broader 2026 QBI announcement.
upcoming_milestones.title: Close the umbrella QBI 2026 announcement

upcoming_milestones.summary: The report covers platform operations, integration, users, research outcomes, partnerships, and support needs.
upcoming_milestones.title: Submit the first annual Genesis Mission progress report

upcoming_milestones.summary: Actions include starting a NIST migration pilot, reporting on National Security Systems, accelerating module validation, and proposing a PQC contractor rule.
upcoming_milestones.title: NIST, NSA, and the FAR Council complete the order's initial 180-day actions

upcoming_milestones.summary: The center is directed to develop tools for accurately assessing quantum-computing systems.
upcoming_milestones.title: Establish a national quantum-computing assessment center

upcoming_milestones.summary: The work covers potential cost, scope, time frame, and mechanisms such as advance market commitments.
upcoming_milestones.title: Explore private-sector partnership models and commercial contribution plans

upcoming_milestones.summary: NSF states that it plans to make the transition by December 2026, pending funding availability.
upcoming_milestones.title: Advance selected NSF NQVL projects from design to implementation

upcoming_milestones.summary: The order calls for public cryptographic bill of materials guidance and a proposed contractor vulnerability-disclosure rule.
upcoming_milestones.title: CISA and the FAR Council publish cryptographic inventory and disclosure proposals

upcoming_milestones.summary: The assessment explicitly includes implications for migration to post-quantum cryptography.
upcoming_milestones.title: Report national-security implications of increasing commercial quantum capability

upcoming_milestones.summary: The pilot covers an appropriate subset of NIST-owned or operated information systems.
upcoming_milestones.title: Complete the NIST post-quantum cryptography migration pilot

upcoming_milestones.summary: DOE states that the Q Competition aims for a 2028 demonstration.
upcoming_milestones.title: Demonstrate fault-tolerant systems with logical qubits in the low hundreds

upcoming_milestones.summary: National Security Systems are excluded from this specific agency requirement and follow NSA-led processes.
upcoming_milestones.title: Transition federal high-value assets and high-impact systems to PQC key establishment

upcoming_milestones.summary: The deadline applies to the systems covered by the OMB guidance directed in Executive Order 14412.
upcoming_milestones.title: Transition federal high-value assets and high-impact systems to PQC digital signatures

upcoming_milestones.summary: DARPA expresses the program goal as determining feasibility by 2033 rather than as a fixed day-level deadline.
upcoming_milestones.title: Determine whether an industrially useful quantum computer is achievable

upcoming_milestones.summary: The public goal is stated as within a decade rather than as a fixed statutory deadline.
upcoming_milestones.title: Double the productivity and impact of American research and engineering
